Welcome to this journey where grace, faith, and the search for worthiness all come together in the ups and downs of spiritual growth.
Imagine for a moment—what if trusting Christ meant more than just believing He exists?
In Stephen E. Robinson's inspiring book, Believing Christ: The Parable of the Bicycle and Other Good News, we get to explore what it really means to not just believe in Christ, but to believe Him—to take His promises to heart, to trust in His mercy, and to lean on His power to change us.
Together, we’ll look at how our own efforts, perfectionism, and self-doubt can sometimes make us miss the simple, freeing message of the gospel. Through vivid stories and down-to-earth analogies—like the unforgettable parable of the bicycle—we’ll see how Christ’s grace fills the gaps we just can’t bridge on our own.
As we walk this path side by side, those familiar worries about not being good enough will meet gentle reassurance. We’ll talk about how forgiveness, acceptance, and real spiritual renewal are possible because of Him.
If you’ve ever wondered whether your best—flawed as it may be—could ever be enough, you’re not alone. This is a place for all of us who are searching for that assurance, and for anyone ready to rediscover the joy and hope at the heart of the “good news.”
So, let’s explore together the warmth, faith, and redemption woven throughout life’s everyday moments, as we discover what it really means to embrace Christ’s love—right where we are.
